summary: xAI released version 1.0.0 of its proto definitions repository, adding a reasoning_content field to the Message proto and new parameters for the Live Search API's X source.

practices.reason: Additive protobuf fields for reasoning content and Live Search parameters mean optional integration work for teams consuming xAI's API, not a breaking change.
practices.quote: Add `reasoning_content` field to Message proto by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-proto/pull/2
